name: pingward
description: Serverless uptime monitor on Cloudflare Workers, D1 and Workers Static Assets

scripts.check: npm run typecheck -w worker && npm test -w worker && npm run lint -w frontend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run dev:worker
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

API_TOKEN.description: Admin token for the dashboard and every write. At least 16 characters of letters, digits and - _ . ~ + / only (no !, @, # or spaces). A UUID works well.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional. Bot token from @BotFather to enable Telegram alerts.
